title: Hyperexcitable VTA-mPFC dopaminergic circuit disrupts sleep spindle and mediates sleep fragmentation after chronic social defeat stress
title_zh: 慢性社会失败压力下，超兴奋的VTA-mPFC多巴胺能回路破坏睡眠棘波并导致睡眠碎片化
abstract: Chronic stress disrupts sleep maintenance, yet its neural basis remains unclear. Here, we demonstrated that mice subjected to chronic social defeat stress exhibit fragmented non-rapid eye movement sleep (NREMs), accompanied by reduced density and quality of sleep spindles. Chronic stress enhances the firing and burst activity of ventral tegmental area dopaminergic (VTADA) neurons, leading to excessive dopamine release in the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC). This dopaminergic surge disrupts the continuity of electroencephalogram (EEG) spindles, thereby disturbing the stability of NREMs. Blocking dopamine signaling along the VTA-mPFC pathway during stress exposure or pharmacologically inhibiting hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated (HCN) channel-mediated Ih currents of VTA neurons after chronic stress attenuated sleep fragmentation and restored normal spindle metrics. Our study identifies aberrant VTADA burst firing as a critical circuit-level contributor to stress-induced sleep disturbance and proposes a potential mechanistic entry point for dissecting dopamine-dependent regulation of NREMs stability.
abstract_zh: 慢性压力会破坏睡眠维持，但其神经基础尚不清楚。我们在此证明，接受慢性社会失败压力的老鼠表现出非快速眼动睡眠（NREM）碎片化，并伴随睡眠棘波密度和质量下降。慢性压力增强腹侧被盖区多巴胺能（VTADA）神经元的放电和突发活动，导致中前额叶皮层（mPFC）多巴胺过度释放。这种多巴胺激增破坏脑电图（EEG）棘波的连续性，从而扰乱NREM的稳定性。在压力暴露期间阻断VTA-mPFC通路的多巴胺信号，或在慢性压力后药理抑制VTA神经元的超极化激活环核苷酸门控（HCN）通道介导的Ih电流，可减轻睡眠碎片化并恢复正常棘波指标。我们的研究确定了异常VTADA突发放电作为压力诱导睡眠障碍的关键回路层面贡献，并提出了一个潜在的机制入口，用于解析多巴胺依赖的NREM稳定性调控。
